newsitem.title: USA: Rubin to visit Vietnam first week in April.
newsitem.headline: Rubin to visit Vietnam first week in April.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Tuesday told reporters that he planned to visit Vietnam in the first week in April.
He said that he met with the finance minister of Vietnam and other Vietnamese officials in Washington, and discussed a lot of issues concerning the country.

"We've now reached agreement in respect to debt ... and we will be going there to further continue our discussions with respect to the Vietnam economy and I very much looking forward to the visit," he said.
Rubin spoke following testimony before the House Budget Committee.
